description: Search CV-Library.co.uk by keyword and UK location, browse an industry sector, or paste CV-Library search and job URLs. No cookies, account or API key are needed.

includeDetails.description: Open each job page for the full description and structured pay fields. Turn off for a faster listing-only run.
includeDetails.title: Fetch full job details

industry.description: Sector to browse for mode=searchByIndustry. The location field still narrows it when set.
industry.title: Industry sector

jobType.description: Keep only one employment type. CV-Library does not allow filter query strings for anonymous clients, so the actor filters matches itself.
jobType.title: Job type

location.description: Town, city, county or postcode, for example 'London', 'Manchester' or 'M1'. Leave blank for UK-wide results.
location.title: UK location

maxItems.description: Hard cap on saved job records.
maxItems.title: Maximum jobs

maxPages.description: Safety cap on result pages fetched per search. Raise it to reach deeper results; 20 jobs are shown per page.
maxPages.title: Maximum result pages

mode.description: Search by keyword and location, browse one industry sector, or scrape specific CV-Library URLs.
mode.title: What to scrape

postedWithinDays.description: Keep jobs posted in this many days. 0 means any date.
postedWithinDays.title: Posted within

query.description: Job title, skill or phrase for mode=searchJobs, for example 'software developer' or 'registered nurse'.
query.title: Search keywords

remoteOnly.description: Use CV-Library's remote search path and keep only remote or work-from-home listings.
remoteOnly.title: Remote jobs only

salaryMax.description: Annual salary ceiling in pounds. Applied to the annualised range.
salaryMax.title: Maximum salary (GBP)

salaryMin.description: Annual salary floor in pounds. Hourly, daily and weekly pay is annualised before comparison. Listings without a parseable salary are excluded when either salary bound is set.
salaryMin.title: Minimum salary (GBP)

sortBy.description: Sort the jobs collected for this run before they are saved.
sortBy.title: Sort results

startUrls.description: For mode=searchByUrl: paste CV-Library search, industry or job URLs, for example 'https://www.cv-library.co.uk/software-developer-jobs-in-london'.
startUrls.title: CV-Library URLs

title: CV-Library UK Vacancy Finder by Industry & Location Input
